scenes.title: Hook: flash-forward to the funnel
scenes.picture: Frame 0, already in motion: Theo is centred in a medium close-up, gripping the wheel with wide eyes. His face is lit warm orange by the compass binnacle, the single warm danger point. Over his shoulder a lightning flash shows the towering waterspout funnel and its white spray ring filling the background. A tense handheld (0.15) dolly-in pushes toward him while rain and spray streak across frame, the tether whips and the deck heels. Overlay reads TORNADO IN THE DARK from 0 to 2.6 s. The moon sits frame left as the geography anchor.

scenes.title: Rewind: alone in the Triangle
scenes.picture: A time-skip card reads MINUTES EARLIER and gives way to a 24 mm aerial establishing pullback. The small sloop sails alone on a calm moonlit sea, with the moon frame left and the mast light glowing. The camera crane-descends into the cockpit, where exhausted Theo nods at the helm and the warm compass binnacle and wheel sit in the foreground. The distance badge appears for the first time: SPOUT 800 M.

scenes.title: Flight 19 across the moon
scenes.picture: A slow 24 mm pedestal up from the sloop's masthead to the moon (frame left). Five faint TBM Avenger silhouettes fade respectfully across the moon disc in loose formation and dissolve away. No crash is shown.

scenes.title: Threat reveal: the spiral he can't see
scenes.picture: From about 7.5 s to 9.5 s, Theo is centred and dozing at the wheel, his face warm from the binnacle. A distant lightning flicker behind him lights a dark spot and a faint spiral pattern on the water off his starboard quarter. The camera dolly-ins slowly over his shoulder toward the spiral, holding at least 2 s. He does not stir. The SPOUT 800 M badge stays visible as dramatic irony.

scenes.title: Inciting incident: he sees it
scenes.picture: A bright lightning flash. Theo jolts awake and his head snaps toward the starboard quarter. An 85 mm realization push-in holds on his face, which is warm against the cold flash. Rain begins to streak across frame.

scenes.title: Taller than the mast
scenes.picture: A 21 mm low reveal from the deck rises past the sloop's mast to the full spinning waterspout column, joining sea to cloud and clearly taller than the mast. This re-establishes the stormy sea, with the spout on frame right and the moon glow frame left behind the cloud.

scenes.title: The tornado kind
scenes.picture: A 110 mm threat orbit_cw on the funnel's base shows a dark thundercloud wall and frequent lightning, the signature of the tornadic kind. The camera cuts back to Theo's fearful face, centred. The badge drops to SPOUT 400 M.

scenes.title: Instinct: fire up and run
scenes.picture: A 28 mm action shot follows Theo as he turns the engine key and slams the throttle forward. Exhaust coughs and the stern squats. The camera trucks with him as he steers dead away from the spout, which stays frame right behind him. A MISTAKE caption hits.

scenes.title: Channel sixteen
scenes.picture: A 50 mm close shot with handheld 0.15. Theo, centred, keys the VHF handset while steering one-handed. The radio display glows CH 16. Static crackles, and the rain-blurred empty horizon behind him shows how far away help is.

scenes.title: It slides down the wake
scenes.picture: A 24 mm high reveal looking down the sloop's white wake. The spout slides along exactly the same line, staying in the boat's track. The camera crane-rises to show both on one axis.

scenes.title: Five stages: watch the water
scenes.picture: A 35 mm pedestal down that tilts away from the funnel to the sea surface at its base. A five-pip stage indicator overlay appears and stays composited later. Theo, centred in the foreground, drops his gaze from the cloud to the water.

scenes.title: Midpoint reveal: the full funnel
scenes.picture: A rapid lightning strobe lights the full funnel from sea to cloud while the spray ring tears the sea white around its base. The camera crane-rises to an aerial view showing the tiny sloop beside the colossal vortex.

scenes.title: Stage three spray ring
scenes.picture: A 65 mm fear push on the churning white spray ring at the spout's base. The stage indicator lights pip 3 and the badge drops to SPOUT 200 M.

scenes.title: It's closing
scenes.picture: An over-the-shoulder shot from behind Theo, centred, at the wheel. The spout looms larger behind the stern rail. Handheld 0.15 as the deck heels and spray lashes him.

scenes.title: Step one: never steer closer
scenes.picture: A 50 mm decision shot. Theo's hand starts to drift the wheel toward the spout, then he stops and holds it away. A STEP 1 badge pushes in.

scenes.title: Step two: track the ring
scenes.picture: A 35 mm arc track around Theo, centred, as he watches the spray ring. A faint motion-trail line is composited across the water showing the ring's drift direction. A STEP 2 badge appears.

scenes.title: Climax: stage four swings to the bow
scenes.picture: A whip pan into a highest-contrast moon-blue frame. The vortex tightens to maturity and the spray ring swings across toward the bow. The stage indicator lights pip 4 and the badge reads SPOUT 60 M. Panic handheld (0.35).

scenes.title: Stay with me
scenes.picture: A 75 mm intimate close-up on Theo's face, centred and warm from the binnacle, as the roar builds behind him. A 0.15 s silence hold freezes the rain mid-air before the cut.

scenes.title: Step three: ninety degrees
scenes.picture: An extreme close-up of the compass card swinging through 90 degrees. Theo, centred, puts the helm hard over and the sloop heels as it turns broadside to the spout's path. The camera pullback-reveals to a 24 mm wide shot that re-establishes the boat now crossing perpendicular to the spout's track. A STEP 3 badge appears, and the distance badge reads SPOUT 30 M.

scenes.title: It tears past the stern
scenes.picture: A 28 mm orbit track. The funnel and spray ring roar past just astern, drenching the cockpit, then continue on their original line. Theo, centred, soaked and clipped on by his tether, exhales as the camera settles to calm handheld (0.05).

scenes.title: Sting: the spout recedes
scenes.picture: A 24 mm dolly-out from the sloop, centred, as the spout recedes toward the horizon. The clouds part and the moon (frame left) silvers the sea. The edit hard-cuts on the unfinished word, matched to frame 0 for the loop.

elements.name: Open Atlantic, Bermuda Triangle, at night
must_do: establish isolation with an empty horizon
hold the moon frame left as the geography anchor
swell calm in setup, then build to storm seas

elements.name: Small sloop cockpit with helm
must_do: heel and pitch with the sea
frame Theo centred at the wheel
catch rain and spray on surfaces

elements.name: Procedural night ocean surface
must_do: show dark spot, spiral and foam displacement under the spout

elements.name: Theo, solo sailor
must_do: steer and turn the wheel hard over

elements.name: Flight 19 TBM Avenger silhouettes
must_do: fade across the moon in formation of five

elements.name: Glowing compass binnacle
must_do: be planted in the hook and context
swing its card through 90 degrees in the payoff

elements.name: Ship's wheel
must_do: spin hard over in the payoff

elements.name: Marine VHF radio handset
must_do: glow with CH 16 on its display

elements.name: Spray ring at the spout's base
must_do: drench the cockpit as it passes

elements.name: Dark spot and spiral on the water
must_do: be revealed by a lightning flicker for 2 s

elements.name: Sloop's white wake
must_do: show the spout following in its line

elements.name: Whitewater foam texture
must_do: whiten the sea under the spray ring

elements.name: Hook text TORNADO IN THE DARK
SPOUT distance badge
must_do: read 800 M, 400 M, 200 M, 60 M, then 30 M

elements.name: STEP 1/2/3 badges
must_do: push in on each step line

elements.name: Spray-ring path trail
must_do: draw the ring's drift direction across the water

elements.name: Kinetic captions (Inter 900)
must_do: show one to three words per page in sync with the VO

elements.name: Facial and body acting rig
must_do: drive doze, startle, fear, decision and relief expressions
drive hand actions on the wheel and radio

elements.name: Boat buoyancy and heel rig
must_do: heel, pitch and roll the sloop and cockpit with the sea and the hard turn
